s1.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: weight loss without fever or sweats
key_facts: male patient in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
normal complete blood cell count and metabolic panel
normal viral and rheumatologic panels
normal chest radiograph and high-resolution chest CT scan
mild restrictive disease on pulmonary function tests
skin biopsy showing nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate
atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples
lymphocytes with atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

raw.syndrome_frame: inflammatory arthritis and skin lesions with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: weight loss without fever or sweats
key_facts: male patient in his 50s
dermal papules on trunk and extremities
preference for extensor surfaces of arms and legs
no lymphadenopathy
normal complete blood cell count and metabolic panel
normal viral and rheumatologic panels

atypical lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
low CD4 signal and robust CD8 signal on immunostaining
clonal rearrangements identified in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples
lymphocytes with atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype

differentials: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis
per_call: Interstitial lung disease associated with rheumatoid arthritis

raw.rationale: The presence of clonal rearrangements in skin biopsy and bone marrow samples, along with atypical lymphocytes and a nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate, supports the diagnosis of Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma. The patient's skin lesions and systemic symptoms, such as fatigue and weight loss, are also consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Erythema elevatum diutinum
rejected.why: Lack of characteristic neutrophilic infiltrate and leukocytoclastic vasculitis in skin biopsy

rejected.label: Lymphomatoid papulosis
rejected.why: Absence of typical wedge-shaped lymphocytic infiltrate and lack of response to previous treatments

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: No muscle weakness or elevated muscle enzymes, and skin biopsy does not show characteristic perifascicular atrophy

rejected.label: Rheumatoid arthritis
rejected.why: Normal complete blood cell count, metabolic panel, and rheumatologic panels, and lack of characteristic erosive joint changes on hand radiographs
